errors.evidence: The chart displays six categories, not five. The category 'Не може да прецени' (Cannot judge) is missed in this count.

This is a horizontal bar chart, meaning the categories are on the vertical axis and the values (represented by the bars' lengths) are on the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly reverses this structure.
The category label is 'Много по-лесен' (Much easier), not 'Много по-тесен' (Much narrower). This is a misreading of the text.
The category label is 'Малко по-лесен' (A little easier), not 'Малко по-тесен' (A little narrower). This is a misreading of the text.

errors.evidence: The categories are arranged vertically from top to bottom, not horizontally from left to right. Furthermore, they are not in alphabetical order.

errors.text_span: която показва процента на хората с дадения икономически статус, имащи достъп до здравеопазване
errors.evidence: This is a misinterpretation of the chart's purpose. The chart shows the percentage of survey respondents who hold a certain opinion about the difference in healthcare access between rich and poor, not the percentage of people of a certain economic status who have access to healthcare.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете „Много по-тесен“ и „Много по-труден“ достигат до височината 71,4 и 2,7 съответно, докато стълбовете „Малко по-тесен“ и „Приблизително същия“ показват височината 20,9 и 3,6, а стълбовете „Малко по-труден“ и „Не може да прецени“ имат височината 0,6 и 0,8.
errors.evidence: There are multiple mapping errors in this sentence. The value for 'Много по-труден' is 0.8, not 2.7. The value for 'Не може да прецени' is 2.7, not 0.8. The description has swapped the values for these two categories. It also repeats the label misreading ('по-тесен' instead of 'по-лесен').

The description fails to mention the central question of the chart, which is a comparison of healthcare access for the rich versus the poor in Bulgaria. It only vaguely mentions 'оценки на достъпа до здравеопазване'.
